descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · S31 「生产上保留和清除在跑：清除任务已注册、上次运行是绿的、窗口等于 3.6」 Retention and purge are running on production: purge jobs registered, last run green, windows equal 3.6

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T6 Retention and purge are live in production (TFA-94699), as part of the PHI gate. Behavior is tested in OAT-04; here it is a gate item only.（TFA-94059 AC 7） — gate: blocked: TFA-94059 in progress; TFA-94699 in progress

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Tim, reading the production Convex dashboard (scheduled functions and crons, function logs, env names); no patient data read

When Capture, dated: the registered crons, with the lifecycle purge jobs and their last runs; the retention configuration values the purge uses (configuration, not hard-coded, per 3.6); and the OAT-04 result on production, attached (per Q10).

Then Every lifecycle purge job is registered and has a successful run in the last 24 h. The retention values equal the 3.6 Hospital and Nursing Home windows. The OAT-04 production result is attached.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：TFA-94059 AC 7 'Retention and purge live in prod (TFA-94699)', as part of the PHI gate. A missing purge job, a failing last run, or a window different from 3.6 is a Fail, quoted with the job or value. Purge behavior itself is OAT-04.

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 CONFIG · 配置核对；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S31 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-05.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：CONFIG · 配置核对；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 dev 跑；来源：dev。
